description: Scaffold Vite + React + TypeScript app in /frontend with all core dependencies: react, react-dom, react-konva, konva, zustand, @supabase/supabase-js. Configure TypeScript strict mode, Vite aliases, and add vitest for testing. Include npm scripts: dev, build, test, typecheck, lint.
steps: Create /frontend directory and initialize with: npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts (or equivalent manual setup)
Install production dependencies: react, react-dom, react-konva, konva, zustand, @supabase/supabase-js
Install dev dependencies: vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, @types/react, @types/react-dom, eslint, typescript
Configure tsconfig.json with strict mode, path aliases (@/ -> src/), target ES2022
Configure vite.config.ts with path aliases and vitest integration
Create src/ directory structure: components/, stores/, lib/, types/, hooks/, canvas/, canvas/layers/
Add npm scripts in package.json: dev, build, preview, test, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), lint
Create a minimal src/App.tsx that renders a placeholder div to verify the scaffold works
Create src/vite-env.d.ts for Vite type declarations
Run npm run build to verify the scaffold compiles cleanly
Run npm run typecheck to verify TypeScript has no errors
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors in /frontend
npm run typecheck completes with 0 errors
All listed dependencies are in package.json
Directory structure src/components, src/stores, src/lib, src/types, src/hooks, src/canvas, src/canvas/layers exists
